_doc: Where each resort measures the snowfall it reports (the single headline number OnTheSnow carries). elev_ft = the plot / stake that feeds daily and season totals; 'other' lists further plots the resort also publishes. Resorts not listed: no published plot elevation found (2026-11); model2.py puts them at DEFAULT_FRACTION of the vertical.
_default_fraction_note: Median position of the plots below is ~0.63 of the way from base to summit (range 0.33-0.84), so 'mid-mountain' (0.5) is a little low for the typical reporting plot.

Alta.where: Collins study plot, mid-mountain; manual 12 h boards

Palisades Tahoe.where: upper plot in Alpine Bowl near top of Roundhouse; headline and season totals

Jackson Hole.where: Rendezvous Bowl plot (with Raymer 9,360 ft) = 'summit' daily and season totals

Vail.where: Mid-Vail stake on the snow report; official season record kept at patrol HQ near the top of chairs 4/5/11 (~11,250 ft)

Mammoth Mountain.where: ski patrol snow study site near Main Lodge / chair 11 (8,900-9,000 ft); season totals are 'at Main Lodge'

Big Sky.where: several patrol stakes (Lobo, Bavaria, Headwaters ~9,000 ft); storm stakes are left to accumulate

Whistler Blackcomb.where: Pig Alley plot, 1,650 m, sheltered trees below the Roundhouse; alpine not measured (wind)

Revelstoke Mountain Resort.where: The Ripper plot, 1,950 m, sheltered tree-line stake
